results.question: How many vacation days do full-time employees get each year?
results.answer:
# Northwind Labs Leave Policy

Applies to all full-time and part-time employees. Contractors are covered by the Contractor Guide instead.

## Vacation

Full-time employees receive 20 vacation days per calendar year. Vacation accrues at 1.67 days per month of service, starting on the first day of employment. Part-time employees accrue vacation in proportion to their contracted hours.

Up to 5 unused vacation days can be carried over into the next calendar year. Carried-over days must be used by March 31; any carried-over days left after that date are forfeited. Unused vacation is not paid out, except where local law requires it.

Vacation requests of three or more consecutive days must be submitted in the HR Portal at least two weeks in advance and approved by your manager.

## Sick leave

Employees receive 10 paid sick days per year. Sick days do not carry over. A doctor's note is required after 3 consecutive sick days.

## Parental leave

results.question: How long is parental leave for the primary caregiver?
results.answer:
## Sick leave

Employees receive 10 paid sick days per year. Sick days do not carry over. A doctor's note is required after 3 consecutive sick days.

## Parental leave

The primary caregiver receives 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave. The secondary caregiver receives 6 weeks of fully paid parental leave. Parental leave must be taken within 12 months of the birth or adoption.

Employees receive up to 5 paid days of bereavement leave for the loss of an immediate family member, and 2 days for an extended family member.

## Public holidays

Public holidays follow the calendar of the office you are assigned to. They do not count against vacation days.

results.question: Within how many days do I have to submit an expense?
results.answer:
# Northwind Labs Expense Policy

This policy covers business expenses paid by employees and later reimbursed.

## Submitting expenses

Submit expenses in the Finance Portal within 30 days of the purchase. An itemized receipt is required for any expense over $25. Expenses submitted after 90 days will not be reimbursed.

Reimbursements are paid with the next monthly payroll after approval.

## Approval limits

- Up to $1,000: your manager approves.
- $1,000 to $5,000: a director approves.
- Above $5,000: a VP approves, and Finance must be notified before the purchase.

## Meals

The meal allowance while travelling is up to $75 per day for domestic travel and up to $100 per day for international travel. Alcohol is not reimbursable unless it is part of an approved client dinner.

## Travel

Book flights through the travel tool. Economy class is required for flights under 6 hours. Premium economy is allowed for flights of 6 hours or longer. Business class requires VP approval.

results.question: Which days do Berlin employees work from the office?
results.answer:
# Northwind Labs Remote and Hybrid Work Guidelines

## Hybrid schedule

Employees assigned to the Bangalore or Berlin office work from the office 2 days per week, on Tuesday and Thursday. The remaining days can be worked from home.

Fully remote arrangements require approval from a VP and are reviewed every year.

## Core hours

Core collaboration hours are 11:00 to 15:00 in your local time zone. Meetings should be scheduled within core hours whenever possible.

## Coworking spaces

Employees who live more than 50 km from an office can be reimbursed up to $200 per month for a coworking space membership.

## Working from another country

You may work from a country other than the one you are employed in for up to 30 days per calendar year. Any longer stay needs approval from HR and Legal because of tax and immigration rules.

## Equipment

Remote employees use the same company laptop as office employees. Home internet costs are not reimbursed.

results.question: What is the meal cap for contractors travelling for Northwind?
results.answer:
# Northwind Labs Contractor Guide

This guide covers independent contractors engaged through a statement of work. Contractors are not employees, and the employee Leave Policy and Expense Policy do not apply to them except where stated here.

## Invoicing and payment

Contractors invoice monthly, by the 5th day of the following month. Invoices are paid on net-30 terms.

## Time off

Contractors are not eligible for paid vacation, paid sick leave, or parental leave. Planned absences longer than 3 working days should be agreed with the engagement manager two weeks in advance.

## Expenses

Contractors are not eligible for the home office stipend. Travel requested by Northwind is reimbursed against receipts, with meals capped at $50 per day.

## Devices and access

Contractors normally use their own laptop, which must be enrolled in device management before receiving access to any Northwind system. Contractor access expires automatically at the end date of the statement of work.

results.question: What percentage of dependents' health insurance premium does Northwind pay?
results.answer:
Northwind Labs Benefits Summary 2026 - Health
Health insurance covers the employee and up to 4 dependents, such as a spouse, partner, or children.
Northwind pays 100% of the premium for the employee and 50% of the premium for each dependent.
Coverage starts on the first day of employment. Annual hospitalization cover is up to $40,000 per family.
An annual health check-up is free for employees and their spouse or partner.

results.question: How much does the company match for retirement contributions, and when does it vest?
results.answer:
Northwind Labs Benefits Summary 2026 - Retirement and Learning
Retirement plan: Northwind matches employee contributions up to 6% of base salary.
The company match vests after 1 year of service. Employee contributions vest immediately.
Learning budget: every employee receives $1,500 per year for courses, books, and conferences.
Unused learning budget does not carry over to the next year.
